title: [Master] - Slice 640775: [Sustainability] Reverse Sustainability part when reverse in GL Entries
summary: Sustainability ledger entries are now reversed when their related general ledger or fixed asset transactions are reversed, with the sustainability ledger entries linked by transaction number and the fixed asset's CO2e totals automatically negated.
key_points: Sustainability ledger entries are matched to GL transactions via transaction number
Reversing a GL or FA transaction now reverses linked sustainability entries
Already-reversed entries are skipped to prevent double reversal
Fixed asset acquisition CO2e totals are negated during reversal
New GL posting event passes transaction number for reversal tracking
quote: When a G/L transaction that included a sustainability part is reversed (Reverse Transaction), the sustainability part is now reversed too.
